_note: The simulated family home that sim/casa/casa-ctl drives. IPs are ping-shim identities (sandbox/lan/ping answers iff $SANDBOX_RUN/lan/hosts/<ip> exists); real listeners all live on 127.0.0.1 loopback ports so nothing ever touches a real LAN. truenas's ping identity is 127.0.0.1 because check-tcp-port pings the SAME address it connects to (TCP_HOST) - connecting to a literal 192.168.1.x could reach a real device on the developer's LAN. Port 18446 (not the sandbox's 18445): sandbox/.run's own nas listener may be alive on the same machine, and sharing its port made a stopped casa NAS look healthy.
